result.summary: Found 1 issue: a minor layout spacing problem in the "Fastest near you" restaurant cards.

issues.description: The vertical spacing between the thumbnail image and the restaurant title in the "Fastest near you" cards is noticeably too small, causing the text to appear cramped and nearly touch the image above it.
issues.suggestion: Increase the top margin or padding of the text container below the image to provide better visual breathing room, aligning it more closely with the spacing used in the "Popular right now" cards.
